calls.video_title: Market Volatility Is Back — Here’s How to Profit in 15 Minutes
calls.thesis: Guest Kareem: recommend buying NUV (Nuveen municipal bond closed-end fund) at current levels, keep adding and reinvest dividends; trading closer to its 52-week low. Pays 4.73% tax-free monthly — a 6.14% taxable-equivalent yield at the 30% bracket and about 6.7% at 35% — with under 1% historical muni default rates, 80%+ investment grade, no leverage and 2-3m shares a day of liquidity; capital appreciation possible if rates fall. First tracked MarketBeat call on NUV.
